decisions.reason: Having survived the initial learning period as a core garage-door operator line, it likely meets a satisfactory aspiration level and remains valuable for system sales and channel support.

This operator variant is close to the core offer and likely still acceptable, though its overlap with the broader operator line creates some chance of later consolidation rather than immediate withdrawal.

The glazed industrial sectional door still fits the established industrial range, but its more specialized position and similarity to related products leave a moderate risk of portfolio rationalization if results fall short of aspirations.

Because this glazed industrial sectional door had stronger apparent commitment and has remained in the portfolio for several years, management would usually continue it unless newer evidence clearly undercuts its performance aspiration.
